A '''radar eye''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component used on [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. R-series droids had a large circular Radar Eye on their domed head,<ref name="EGTD" /> sharing space with the droid's [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]].<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref> The only R-series droid not to feature a radar eye was the [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]], which replaced it with three separate [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="EGTD" />
